meta.listDescription: Find any Deadlock hero fast: search, filter by role and complexity, and compare win rate, pick rate and trend.
meta.detailDescription: {hero} in Deadlock: win rate, pick rate, matchups, builds and ability order, from match data.

list.title: Hero directory
list.description: Find a hero fast. Numbers use the same rules as the Meta page: low samples are muted and trends need non-overlapping intervals.
list.searchHint: Press / to search from anywhere on this page.
list.noMatchDescription: Try a different name, or clear the role and complexity filters.

detail.trendMissing: Trend: not enough data for both weeks
detail.noStats: No matches for this hero in the selected scope.
detail.bestMatchupsOverview: Lane opponents with 100+ games, ranked by the low end of the interval.
detail.worstMatchupsOverview: Lane opponents ranked by the high end of the interval.
detail.bestBuildDescription: Most-played tracked build (selected at game start).
detail.noBuilds: No community builds found for this hero.
detail.noOrderData: Not enough ability-order data in this scope.
detail.lengthDescription: Win rate by how long the match lasted.
detail.emptyLane: No lane opponent has enough games yet.
detail.emptyPartner: No partner has enough matches together yet.
detail.orderStats: Used in {share} of tracked orders · <rate>{winRate}</rate> win rate
detail.buildsDescription: This week’s most-favorited community builds. Win rate counts matches where the build was selected at game start; changes during the match aren’t tracked.
detail.progressionDescription: Shop items bought in at least {rate} of this hero’s matches, by average buy time.
detail.itemCaveat: Item win rates are shown small on purpose: players who are already ahead buy more items sooner, so an item’s win rate partly reflects the lead, not the item.
detail.bestMatchupsLane: {count, plural, one {# lane opponent} other {# lane opponents}} with 100+ games. Ranked by the low end of the interval.
detail.bestMatchupsAny: {count, plural, one {# opponent} other {# opponents}} in any lane with 100+ games. Ranked by the low end of the interval.
detail.worstMatchupsDescription: Ranked by the high end of the interval.
detail.synergiesDescription: Teammates in any lane, 100+ matches together, ranked by the low end of the interval.
detail.emptyOpponent: Not enough games against any opponent.
detail.abilitiesEmptyDescription: No ability order has 100+ matches in this scope. Try a longer window or a wider rank band.
detail.abilityOrderDescription: The most common first {count} upgrades. Full orders aren’t compared because longer games allow more upgrades, which skews their win rates.
detail.rankDescription: Win rate by match average rank (selected window). The rank filter doesn’t apply here, and matches without an average rank aren’t counted, so these can differ from the overall rate.
detail.patchDescription: Win rate in the 7 days before each patch vs the 7 days after (or until the next patch).
detail.noPatches: No patches in the last 60 days.
detail.verdictNote: “Higher/lower after” means the two windows’ 95% intervals don’t overlap. It doesn’t say what in the patch caused it.
detail.matchesEmptyDescription: No recent matches with this hero were found for this rank band.
detail.matchesDescription: The most recent matches with this hero that the data source has processed. Samples, not a summary.

parts.splitValue: {group}: {rate} over {count, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}}
parts.splitValueLow: {group}: {rate} over {count, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}}, low sample
parts.splitLegend: Bar = win rate (scale {scale}, center line 50%). Light whisker = 95% interval.
parts.splitClear: The highlighted group is clearly ahead.
parts.splitUnclear: No group is clearly ahead: intervals overlap.
parts.moreSections: +{count} more sections in the full build
parts.buildNoMatches: No tracked matches for this build in this scope.
parts.buildWinRate: win rate when selected at game start
parts.noPhaseItems: No common items in this phase.
parts.itemWinRate: Win rate of matches where the item was bought

trendChart.tooFew: Not enough daily data to draw a trend.
trendChart.incomplete: The latest day may be incomplete.
trendChart.tableCaption: {metric} by day, the values behind the chart
